Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Jason Michael Brescia was born on 1943-06-09, instead of his correct birth date of 1986-06-19. This led to the erroneous conclusion that Brescia was born earlier than Oscar Barney Finn, who was actually born on 1938-10-28. The error originated from the Planner confusing the birth dates between the two directors.
